title: Resource and stop rules
summary: Small context; one task per worker; no recursive spawning or repeated model status polling.
body:
Small context; one task per worker; no recursive spawning or repeated model status polling.

Focused checks for a local change; broader regression at integration.

Original proposed worker deadline: 20 minutes, with saved progress; not certified as enforced.

No automatic restart or credit purchase. Record attempts, waiting/execution time and available usage.

Account allowance is separate from per-task usage; no invented credit accounting.

The development view also identifies the active agent/model, current task, execution versus waiting time, attempts, design escalations and latest saved result. Earlier model-specific escalation names are historical. None of these planned controller limits is certified by the memory migration.
